event_chain.summary: External servers breached, method not disclosed

summary: Around Dec 18 2025 a threat actor using the alias '888' claimed on BreachForums and DarkForums to have breached the European Space Agency and stolen over 200 GB of data including private Bitbucket repositories, source code, CI/CD pipelines, API and access tokens, configuration and Terraform files, SQL files, confidential documents and hardcoded credentials, reportedly including documents involving Airbus, SpaceX and Thales Alenia Space. ESA confirmed a breach of a small number of servers outside its corporate network that support unclassified collaborative engineering activities and opened a forensic investigation.
